scope: Broaden the open-source DXF peer and downstream-consumer screen to identify narrow independent structural or explicit-mesh projection routes without conflating them with ACIS, AcDs, or B-rep support.

method.kind: Primary project repositories, API documentation, project-authored format/support notes
method.statusCaveat: Repository branches and wiki/docs pages may be mutable or stale. No runtime behavior was verified. Peer admission is for a future optional composed checkpoint only.

routes.name: DIME
routes.evidence: Separate C++ DXF read/write library with typed 3DFACE, POLYLINE, INSERT/block and unknown-entity classes, plus polygon/line/point geometry extraction and a VRML sample converter. Its published documentation reports testing DXF versions 10-14 and customer use with AutoCAD 2000. The source/docs reviewed do not establish modern-version coverage, exact unknown-record roundtrip, polyface details, Binary DXF support, or modeler/AcDs semantics.
routes.admission: DISCOVERY_ONLY / OPTIONAL_DXF_STRUCTURAL_AND_EXPLICIT_PROJECTION. Pin exact source commit, build, host, and tested file magic/version; generate controls locally. Treat documented DXB support separately from Binary DXF.
doesNotProve: closed B-rep validity or native CAD acceptance

routes.name: Blender DXF add-on
routes.evidence: The reviewed source implements projection of explicit 3DFACE and mesh-family records into Blender BMesh, exposes block and merge modes, and performs geometry normalization such as duplicate-point removal and intersecting-quad splitting. The repository page says the add-on repository was archived on 2025-05-09; metadata identifies add-on version 0.9.8 and Blender 2.80. No ACIS path was found in the inspected importer.
routes.admission: Optional advisory explicit-mesh consumer only. Pin Blender and add-on revisions, disable merge/recenter/georeference, state block mode, and compare against a locally authored analytic/topology manifest. If source-handle mapping is unavailable, score only aggregate mesh projection.
doesNotProve: DXF entity identity or owner/block graph closure without traceable handles

routes.name: OpenSCAD DXF route
routes.evidence: Project-authored documentation describes OpenSCAD's DXF import as 2D data; its wiki's older comparative library matrix uses broad 2D/3D labels but explicitly disclaims exhaustive testing.
routes.admission: Exclude from 3D DXF/ACIS semantic comparison. Use only for its exact 2D import route if separately useful.

implementationReadiness: Keep peer use optional and at the existing composed checkpoint, never in per-slice fast validation.
If unavailable or unpinned, record NOT_RUN and continue local implementation.
Generate controls locally from scratch in temporary storage; add no external drawing fixture.
Keep parse/version, entity/owner closure, opaque-carrier preservation, explicit mesh projection, B-rep validity, and native acceptance as separate evidence axes.
DIME or Blender can at most inform the exact parse/structural/projection behavior exercised; neither is an ACIS/B-rep semantic oracle.
